payload.title: The AlertTriggered event carries no module or siteId although alert-engine stores both on the alarm's history row, and notification-service declares a private copy of the event instead of importing the contract, so alarm notifications cannot be filtered by module and the two shapes drift
evidence: libs/event-contracts/src/alert-events.ts:30-45 (AlertTriggeredEvent has no module and no siteId)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/services/alert-evaluation.service.ts:490-515 (the producer builds version 2 with trigger fields only)
apps/alert-engine/src/alert/entities/alert-history.entity.ts:73-83 (the same alarm's history row stores siteId and module)
apps/notification-service/src/notification/event-handlers/alert-triggered.handler.ts:71-90 (a local AlertTriggeredEvent interface duplicates the contract)
apps/notification-service/src/notification/event-handlers/alert-triggered.handler.ts:9 (only EventId is imported from the contracts library)
payload.rule_violated: D4 makes alert module-scoped, and event shapes have one owner in libs/event-contracts (one concept, one owner)
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-22, release R7.
